items.verbatim: JOB LADDERS IN THE STEM SKILLED TECHNICAL WORKFORCE -A MAJOR PART OF THE STEM WORKFORCE, REFERRED TO AS THE SKILLED TECHNICAL WORKFORCE (STW), IS COMPOSED OF WORKERS WITH LESS THAN A BACHELOR'S DEGREE PERFORMING JOBS THAT REQUIRE TECHNICAL SKILLS. THIS PROJECT USES A CAREER APPROACH TO MAP THE JOBS

items.category: 訓練・インフラ・その他
items.summary: National Opinion Research Center(NORC、シカゴ大学)がNational Science Foundationより$85,390を受領し、アジア系アメリカ人・ネイティブハワイアン・太平洋諸島系(AANHPI)コミュニティに関するベンチマーク調査データ基盤の構築に用いる。
items.verbatim: DATA EQUITY FOR AANHPI COMMUNITIES -IN THIS PROJECT, A LARGE PROBABILITY PANEL FROM ASIAN AMERICAN, NATIVE HAWAIIAN, AND PACIFIC ISLANDER (AANHPI) POPULATIONS IS EXPANDED AND LEVERAGED TO ESTABLISH A MAJOR BENCHMARKING SURVEY OF AANHPI ADULTS. AANHP COMMUNITIES HAVE BEEN SUBSTANTIALLY UNDERREPRESENT
